equilibrium_model: Ideal gas, 2 M <-> D; Kp=(p_D/p_standard)/(p_M/p_standard)^2, with exactly two monomer units per dimer. The inert gas participates in no reaction.

provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled ideal-gas association model, with stipulated Kp and monomer empirical formula. Not an experimental assignment, operating procedure or claim about actual acetic-acid vapor.
